# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-to-late sixties  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer and homemaker  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with rigid angles and graying dark hair tied aggressively in a hard little knot with wire hairpins. As she ages, her hair turns grayer, though her general tall, austere posture remains unchanged until eye strain and headaches weaken her. Her face is naturally stern, though mellowed over time by a subtle sense of humor around her mouth.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla possesses a narrow range of experience and a rigid, unyielding conscience. She is extremely practical, frugal, and highly organized, disdaining romantic affectations or unnecessary emotional displays. Despite her grim exterior and strictness, she harbors a deep capacity for love, tenderness, and an underlying sense of humor. Over the years of raising children, her outlook mellows considerably, making her more tolerant and expressive of her affections.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v2 c10 P40](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0040), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

- Skilled housewife and cook  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne Shirley into a sensible, capable, and moral woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- To manage and maintain Green Gables despite failing eyesight and financial hardship  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert and her brother Matthew decide to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farmwork at Green Gables. Due to a misunderstanding, an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley is delivered instead. Though Marilla initially intends to send Anne back, she relents after seeing the child's distress and deciding it is her duty to raise her. Over the next several years, Marilla strictly instructs Anne in household chores, morals, and decorum, gradually softening as she grows deeply attached to the girl's spirited personality. When Matthew dies suddenly of a heart attack following a bank failure, Marilla's grief is compound by a specialist's diagnosis that her failing eyesight will lead to blindness if she continues reading or sewing. Unable to manage the farm alone, Marilla prepares to sell Green Gables until Anne gives up her college scholarship to stay in Avonlea and teach. Marilla accepts a proposal for Mrs. Rachel Lynde to move into Green Gables, allowing Anne to attend Redmond College while ensuring Marilla has companionship and assistance in raising her orphan relatives, the twins Davy and Dora.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Green Gables, built by her father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Blythe which ended after an unforgiven quarrel  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived an unvaried life at Green Gables alongside her quiet brother Matthew  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’ve never brought up a child, especially a girl, and I dare say I’ll make a terrible mess of it. But I’ll do my best.  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

> I don't believe in imagining things different from what they really are.  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

> You’re fairly in for it. Did you ever suppose you’d see the day when you’d be adopting an orphan girl?  <sub>[v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you’ve been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
